card.title: Yes, but My Way
card.instruction: Agree with others, then reinterpret the agreement entirely in your favor.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, I'll help you move the sofa. I'll take the cushions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're sewn on. We have to lift together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely. You lift; I'll say when. Together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need another person underneath it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed. I'll book someone on your phone. Then I can give both of you the same countdown.

mechanism: A says yes to moving help while repeatedly redefining their role away from lifting.
confusable: Unlike simply refusing a chore, each evasion must preserve the wording or appearance of agreement.
comparison: D23-a converts physical help into booking and countdowns; D23-b converts dog walking into arranging B's alarm.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
